title: Senthamizh Paattu
desc: Despite his mother's objection to singing songs, Bala develops an interest in music. He falls in love with Durga, a rich girl with whose family his mother's miseries are interlinked.

title: Michael Madana Kama Rajan
desc: A wicked man separates a set of quadruplets after their birth, while one of them ends up with their biological father, the other three find new homes. However, chaos ensues when they cross paths.

title: Dhavani Kanavugal
desc: An older brother tries to get his five younger sisters married but fails due to their poverty. So, he goes to town for work when an incident completely changes his life.

title: Dishyum
desc: Bhaskar, a stuntman, is smitten with Cinthya, a college student. However, his heart is broken when he learns that she doesn't love him back but he still tries to persuade her.

title: Unnai Thedi
desc: Raghu travels to New Zealand with a friend and meets Malavika, whom he falls in love with. However, circumstances force them to part ways.
